thread:
elaine (docs): Quick heads-up: /v1/rerank curl example shows "queries" as a string. That is outdated. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3130
matt (eng): Yep, we removed single-string auto-wrap. The runtime expects an array of objects: [{ query: string, top_k?: number }].
nina (sdk): I will update JS/TS snippets after docs change. Current SDK types are legacy; planning a patch to tighten types and add migration note.
jordan (api): Confirmed. Add migration note: "Previously supported single-string queries are deprecated; send an array of query objects. Results map to queries via query_index."
elaine (docs): Can someone paste a minimal corrected curl + example response I can use in the PR?
matt (eng): Use this snippet:
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"rerank-large-v1","queries":[{"query":"Where is tokenization documented?","top_k":5},{"query":"Dedicated setup?","top_k":3}],"documents":["Doc A","Doc B","Doc C"] }'

matt (eng): Example response (abridged): {"results":[{"query_index":0,"document_indices":[0,2],"scores":[0.97,0.65]},{"query_index":1,"document_indices":[2,0],"scores":[0.88,0.40]}]}

nina (sdk): Thanks. I'll reference docs PR 3130 from SDK PR and include a migration note for users.
elaine (docs): Added curl + response + migration callout and a short note that documents may be strings or objects with id/text. Pushing patch now.
jordan (api): Thanks everyone.
